DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Why not bake him a cake with your name on it?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Why not bake him a cake with your name on it?

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Ask about a bucket of milk
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Ask about a bucket of milk

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: I had a cake, but I lost it.
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: I had a cake, but I lost it.

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: It's a cake, made for you by Slopfinger
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: It's a cake, made for you by Slopfinger

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Did you just write your name in spit?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Did you just write your name in spit?

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: He said, and I quote: "tell Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise".
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: He said, and I quote: "tell Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise".

DefaultChoiceDisplayText.SourceString: Isn't that a Dairy Cow over there?
DefaultChoiceDisplayText.LocalizedString: Isn't that a Dairy Cow over there?

Message.SourceString: Chicken or terrorbird eggs will do. We don't need to get too fancy.
Message.LocalizedString: Chicken or terrorbird eggs will do. We don't need to get too fancy.

Message.SourceString: Tell 'Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise.
Message.LocalizedString: Tell 'Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise.

Message.SourceString: Blimey, I seen a lot of hoomans, but ain't you a big 'un?
Message.LocalizedString: Blimey, I seen a lot of hoomans, but ain't you a big 'un?

Message.SourceString: Name is Slopfinger. I work for Manktongue ova there. I'm his cook, assistant, butler, mass-ooze and hype-goblin.
Message.LocalizedString: Name is Slopfinger. I work for Manktongue ova there. I'm his cook, assistant, butler, mass-ooze and hype-goblin.

Message.SourceString: I'll want four of da blighters, so that the cake will rise as high as my blood pressure.
Message.LocalizedString: I'll want four of da blighters, so that the cake will rise as high as my blood pressure.

Message.SourceString: It's not my for-tay, but I believe it involves farmin'.
Message.LocalizedString: It's not my for-tay, but I believe it involves farmin'.

Message.SourceString: Not that he notices me. Yesterday I was crackin' 'is back an' he called me Sweatmonger. Sweatmonger!
Message.LocalizedString: Not that he notices me. Yesterday I was crackin' 'is back an' he called me Sweatmonger. Sweatmonger!

Message.SourceString: If only I could think of a way to get Manktongue to remember my name...
Message.LocalizedString: If only I could think of a way to get Manktongue to remember my name...

Message.SourceString: Find some wheat seeds and a farmin' patch, and do whatever it is that farmers do. Remember, we need 6 lots of wheat.
Message.LocalizedString: Find some wheat seeds and a farmin' patch, and do whatever it is that farmers do. Remember, we need 6 lots of wheat.

Message.SourceString: You won't need to make flour or anythin'. I like my cakes to look like sad bread.
Message.LocalizedString: You won't need to make flour or anythin'. I like my cakes to look like sad bread.

Message.SourceString: You'll need to milk a Dairy Cow. I don't advise milkin' anything else.
Message.LocalizedString: You'll need to milk a Dairy Cow. I don't advise milkin' anything else.

Message.SourceString: Findin' a dairy cow is the problem. Not so many of them round Ghornfell.
Message.LocalizedString: Findin' a dairy cow is the problem. Not so many of them round Ghornfell.

Message.SourceString: The Dairy Cow chews the wheat without once taking its eyes off you.
Message.LocalizedString: The Dairy Cow chews the wheat without once taking its eyes off you.

Message.SourceString: Is it? Blimey - I thought it were a bear.
Message.LocalizedString: Is it? Blimey - I thought it were a bear.

Message.SourceString: I've been trying not to maintain eye contact. Been on edge this whole conversation.
Message.LocalizedString: I've been trying not to maintain eye contact. Been on edge this whole conversation.

Message.SourceString: We all need help. But you work that out for yoursel'.
Message.LocalizedString: We all need help. But you work that out for yoursel'.

Message.SourceString: Much obliged for yer 'elp.
Message.LocalizedString: Much obliged for yer 'elp.

Message.SourceString: See ya later.
Message.LocalizedString: See ya later.

Message.SourceString: It's smooth, like a wide, hornless unicorn.
Message.LocalizedString: It's smooth, like a wide, hornless unicorn.

Message.SourceString: The Dairy Cow gives you a kick to the shins.
Message.LocalizedString: The Dairy Cow gives you a kick to the shins.

Message.SourceString: Slopfinger said that I need 4 eggs, 6 wheat and a bucket of milk to bake the cake.
Message.LocalizedString: Slopfinger said that I need 4 eggs, 6 wheat and a bucket of milk to bake the cake.

Message.SourceString: You step back from the stove.
Message.LocalizedString: You step back from the stove.

Message.SourceString: The cow rolls its eyes but blushes a little.
Message.LocalizedString: The cow rolls its eyes but blushes a little.

Message.SourceString: You given Slopfinger da news about da raise?
Message.LocalizedString: You given Slopfinger da news about da raise?

Message.SourceString: The Dairy Cow gives you the side-eye.
Message.LocalizedString: The Dairy Cow gives you the side-eye.

Message.SourceString: The Dairy Cow permits you to milk her.
Message.LocalizedString: The Dairy Cow permits you to milk her.

Message.SourceString: The Dairy Cow notes that you have no inventory space and rolls her eyes. You will need to come back when you have room for a bucket of milk.
Message.LocalizedString: The Dairy Cow notes that you have no inventory space and rolls her eyes. You will need to come back when you have room for a bucket of milk.

Message.SourceString: Do you want to put the ingredients inside the stove?
Message.LocalizedString: Do you want to put the ingredients inside the stove?

Message.SourceString: It's a talent. It can't be taught.
Message.LocalizedString: It's a talent. It can't be taught.

Message.SourceString: Next step is to make the cake. You look like ya know yer way 'round a stove. Why don't you have a go?
Message.LocalizedString: Next step is to make the cake. You look like ya know yer way 'round a stove. Why don't you have a go?

Message.SourceString: The cow turns its head expectedly.
Message.LocalizedString: The cow turns its head expectedly.

Message.SourceString: Goodness no! My hands are all wobbly at the thought of Manktongue learnin' ma name.
Message.LocalizedString: Goodness no! My hands are all wobbly at the thought of Manktongue learnin' ma name.

Message.SourceString: That cake is ace. Truly ace.
Message.LocalizedString: That cake is ace. Truly ace.

Message.SourceString: Now, don't look for a moment. I need to apply my sig-nah-ture.
Message.LocalizedString: Now, don't look for a moment. I need to apply my sig-nah-ture.

Message.SourceString: You know what, I utterly forgot that I'm a cook! Yer a genie-ooze.
Message.LocalizedString: You know what, I utterly forgot that I'm a cook! Yer a genie-ooze.

Message.SourceString: The spit will show up well on da frostin'. Now hurry, give the cake to Manktongue.
Message.LocalizedString: The spit will show up well on da frostin'. Now hurry, give the cake to Manktongue.

Message.SourceString: I'll be back here with my heart fully in ma mouth.
Message.LocalizedString: I'll be back here with my heart fully in ma mouth.

Message.SourceString: You close your eyes,  jumble the ingredients together, and place them in the stove. Surely this won't work.
Message.LocalizedString: You close your eyes,  jumble the ingredients together, and place them in the stove. Surely this won't work.

Message.SourceString: ...It worked.
Message.LocalizedString: ...It worked.

Message.SourceString: Oi oi, what do we have 'ere?
Message.LocalizedString: Oi oi, what do we have 'ere?

Message.SourceString: Wait, wot's written on da cake? Does that say Slopfinger? Da goblin over there by the cow?
Message.LocalizedString: Wait, wot's written on da cake? Does that say Slopfinger? Da goblin over there by the cow?

Message.SourceString: Manktongue pushes some cake into his ear, where it nestles next to the pie.
Message.LocalizedString: Manktongue pushes some cake into his ear, where it nestles next to the pie.

Message.SourceString: Give ol' Manktongue a moment.
Message.LocalizedString: Give ol' Manktongue a moment.

Message.SourceString: Hop to it! Fortune waits for no gobber.
Message.LocalizedString: Hop to it! Fortune waits for no gobber.

Message.SourceString: Ooh, the icin' is drip-droppin' on ma eardrum.
Message.LocalizedString: Ooh, the icin' is drip-droppin' on ma eardrum.

Message.SourceString: You have no wheat to feed the cow.
Message.LocalizedString: You have no wheat to feed the cow.

Message.SourceString: Tell 'Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise.
Message.LocalizedString: Tell 'Slopfinger he's earned himself a raise.

Message.SourceString: Oi oi! You got somethin' for ol' Manktongue?
Message.LocalizedString: Oi oi! You got somethin' for ol' Manktongue?

Message.SourceString: Da cake is a lie! Hehe.
Message.LocalizedString: Da cake is a lie! Hehe.

Message.SourceString: Well, come back over when you've made a new 'un.
Message.LocalizedString: Well, come back over when you've made a new 'un.

Message.SourceString: The cow looks supremely confident within its own body. It's to be admired, really.
Message.LocalizedString: The cow looks supremely confident within its own body. It's to be admired, really.

Message.SourceString: I saw the cake go in his lughole! What did he say?
Message.LocalizedString: I saw the cake go in his lughole! What did he say?

Message.SourceString: What a ruddy charmer! He even remembered ma name!
Message.LocalizedString: What a ruddy charmer! He even remembered ma name!

Message.SourceString: I feel a growin' pride in the work I do. I cannot fank you enough.
Message.LocalizedString: I feel a growin' pride in the work I do. I cannot fank you enough.

Message.SourceString: Go give da cake to Manktongue.
Message.LocalizedString: Go give da cake to Manktongue.

Message.SourceString: It ain't much, but I want ya to 'ave this. Perhaps, one day, you will find a boss as good as Manktongue.
Message.LocalizedString: It ain't much, but I want ya to 'ave this. Perhaps, one day, you will find a boss as good as Manktongue.

Message.SourceString: That's certainly a stove.
Message.LocalizedString: That's certainly a stove.

Message.SourceString: Howdy, lankylegs.
Message.LocalizedString: Howdy, lankylegs.

Message.SourceString: Need any help with da stuff?
Message.LocalizedString: Need any help with da stuff?

Message.SourceString: You shall be the assistant's assistant. We will need 4 eggs, 6 lots of wheat and a bucket of milk.
Message.LocalizedString: You shall be the assistant's assistant. We will need 4 eggs, 6 lots of wheat and a bucket of milk.

Message.SourceString: I can tell from the way you're walkin' that you've got bakery stuffs for me.
Message.LocalizedString: I can tell from the way you're walkin' that you've got bakery stuffs for me.

Message.SourceString: If you need any 'elp wiv finding any of it, ya know where I am.
Message.LocalizedString: If you need any 'elp wiv finding any of it, ya know where I am.
